extension.summary: The Physarum slime mould tuned for low-resource devices, with an optional clock in the middle
extension.description:
The Physarum slime mould simulation with the timers stripped out and the clock made optional. This is the same GPU agent model as the full Physarum screensaver, but it never starts over on a schedule and the behaviour never wanders on its own. What is left is the living transport network, growing and reorganising for as long as the screensaver runs.
The clock in the middle is off by default. Switched on, it can sit on top, grow into the digits, stay faintly on top while the slime grows into them, be made of slime (the agents kept inside the digits), or have the network flow around it. While it is off, nothing about the clock runs: no font is loaded, no clock texture is made and the simulation is exactly as light as it was without it.
Every agent senses the trail ahead, ahead-left and ahead-right, turns towards the strongest scent, moves and leaves its own trail, which spreads and fades; together they weave networks that branch, merge and keep reorganising. The slime can start everywhere at random, from a disc, a ring, scattered colonies, a big bang, each species in its own third, or inside the clock digits. Food sources can be scattered so the network links them like a rail map. Eleven behaviours, or Custom (set the sensor angle, turn, sensor distance, step, decay, diffusion, deposit, wobble and repellence yourself), and up to three species that follow their own trail and avoid the others.
This build is made for low-resource devices and its defaults are deliberately light: 16 thousand agents on a 480 x 270 trail, no glow, no screen effect and no clock. The simulation advances one step on every displayed frame, so every frame costs the GPU the same and the picture stays even; if the device cannot keep up, the display rate and the simulation slow together rather than juddering. The scene is drawn at no more than twice the trail resolution (960 x 540 by default) and scaled up, so the most expensive pass costs a quarter of a 1080p draw and a 4K output costs the same again. Raise the agent count, the trail resolution and the glow in the settings if your device can take it, up to 8 million agents on a 3840 x 2160 trail; the agent count and the trail size are the two levers if it still cannot hold a steady frame rate.
extension.disclaimer: Native add-on built for Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android (armeabi-v7a), as on many Google TV boxes. It needs OpenGL ES 2.0 with vertex texture fetch and high-precision floats in fragment shaders. Millions of agents need a strong GPU; start with the default and raise it. The full Physarum screensaver, with the clock on by default and the scheduled restarts, is a separate add-on.
